items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: This is a funny but interesting band: Randy Brecker, Barry Rogers, Dave Taylor, Tom Malone, you, Sato, Ryo Kawasaki, Francisco Santino on bass, and Harvey Mason on drums.

ctx.x: I’ve seen Mike. We did a duo record. We won the Grammy of the year a couple years ago. We did it when I went to Wangaratta. We had never – we hadn’t played since then. They put us together at a midnight show. They recorded it, radio. We put it out as a record. He did a record that is his pieces played by a classical piano player. It’s fantastic, written pieces, classical. Really happening. He didn’t play. It’s his. It’s about 20 of his pieces. It’s a masterpiece. He’s great. Mike’s way up there.
Next is Mashiko Sato, the Japanese keyboard player.
I don’t remember it really, except that’s one of those Japanese combinations.
